endpoint_assumption.name: march_1997_endpoint_assumption
endpoint_assumption.description: Treat the observed 27 March 1997 close as the March endpoint for DT, GS, LX and SS, restoring March and April returns. This is a separate sensitivity, not an amendment to the preserved primary data policy.
endpoint_assumption.source_evidence: Raw closes exist on the specified dates; public-holiday evidence corroborates Easter timing, but exact 1997 venue closure evidence and vendor identity are unverified.

sample.treatment: Requested dates retained; existing minimum-instrument rule leaves portfolios flat below threshold.
